# cubing.js

Unmodified copy of the browser build of [cubing.js](https://github.com/cubing/cubing.js)
0.63.6, as served by `cdn.cubing.net/v0/js/` on 2026-09-23. Only the entry
file was renamed from `cubing/twisty` to `cubing/twisty.js`.

cubing.js is dual-licensed under MPL-2.0 or GPL-3.0-or-later; this copy is used
under the Mozilla Public License 2.0 ([LICENSE-MPL.md](LICENSE-MPL.md)). Source code:
<https://github.com/cubing/cubing.js>, release 0.63.6 on npm
(<https://www.npmjs.com/package/cubing/v/0.63.6>).
